gaps.action: Recover upstream base digest, Void package database/SBOM and corresponding source packages/notices. No exact OS package inventory is available; native hashes are exact bytes, not package version proof.

Map bundled LLVM/OpenMP/CUDA/Vulkan/llama, tree-sitter, curl-impersonate/BoringSSL and Python extension contents to source revisions and all third-party notices. Top-level MIT/other package labels do not establish licensing of every embedded binary.

Reconcile copied donor binary against Node base package/source metadata and GCC runtime exception. Receiver dpkg database cannot certify copied bytes. Donor image was unavailable through bare digest lookup; no image was pulled.

Stage5 must establish a distribution-specific corresponding-source delivery/offer mechanism where required, covering source, patches and build scripts. URLs/digests and notices alone do not fulfill that obligation.
Installed DWS METADATA and project declaration have no license or License-File. Establish distribution rights and applicable repository license with owner; do not invent an SPDX identifier.

gaps.scope: Python origins, SearXNG static assets and vendoring
gaps.action: Recover original wheel/sdist hashes and immutable source revisions, plus complete SearXNG static-asset and embedded/vendored component manifests. Installed METADATA and file hashes do not prove those origins.

No final-image signature/provenance or vulnerability scan verified. Registry base indexes can advertise attestations without verification. Stage5 owns advisory/terms conclusions; no external scanner uploads or tool installs performed.

Browser derived overlay excluded and pending accepted input. Optional hosted providers absent from accepted scaffold/default credentials; enabling requires selected provider/version, credential/data-flow and terms review. SearXNG public search engine behavior remains separately scoped by its qualification.

node_upstream.binding: Source tag resolved to commit; bundled license obtained there. No independent binary-to-source reproducible-build proof.

declared_source_link_policy: Installed metadata URLs are declarations, not verified immutable revisions. npm resolved tarballs are bound by lock integrity; Debian versioned source locators are lookup candidates, not fetched source archives.
